SELECT bill_id, 
       bool_or(sku_scanned = '2900001001014' OR sku_scanned = '2900001001021' OR sku_scanned = '2900001001038') AS has_atta,
       bool_or(sku_scanned = '2900001001311') AS has_oil,
       bool_or(sku_scanned = '2900001001212') AS has_dal
FROM store.pos_lines
GROUP BY bill_id
HAVING has_atta AND has_oil AND has_dal
LIMIT 20;
